comment: Single source of truth for the Qwen3-8B accuracy grid. run_cell.sh resolves
every serve/client knob from here; the protocol name + this file's sha256
land in each cell's provenance.json, so two cells are comparable iff their
protocol hashes match.
Seed convention (user decision, 2026-07-28): NIAH tasks use 3 seeds
(T=0.6/top_p=0.95/top_k=20); every other task uses 5. NIAH rows are the
200-row balanced subsets (25/subtask, round-robin ordered) under
artifacts/prompt_rows_proto/niah_<len>_qwen_s200.jsonl -- reconstructed
from Samuel's samuel_pull_20260727.zip construction method (first 25 rows
per subtask from the full per-length export, interleaved) and verified
byte-identical against his provided 65536/131072 files before extending
to 8192/16384/32768. LCB is 256 rows (lcb_v6_sub256_qwen.jsonl, rids
0-255) -- NOTE this is a contiguous, chronologically-ordered prefix of
the 1055-problem set, not a shuffled sample; Samuel's own PROVENANCE.md
(artifacts/oscar_e2e/from_samuel/PROVENANCE.md) documents an 11-point
method-comparison swing between this subset and the full set. Used here
by explicit user choice, not oversight.
One field encodes a decision that is still open and must be settled
before headline numbers are quoted: exact_chunked_prefill (the
chunked-prefill error confound — false reproduces the published serving
default, true is the exact-math shadow fix).
